note: W9: Cryptographically Bound Streaming Witness & Shard Index Integration. Enforces delta_n == commit(inserted_keys).h, defeating H107 fork injection and epoch inflation attacks. Wires streaming verifier directly to content-addressed SQLite shard store (spikes/M1_8_quorum3/run/store/index.db) with strict 72 B memory invariance and microsecond transition latency. Certified D6 compliant.

controls.name: C1_bound_shard_delta_matches_full_rebuild
controls.must_fire_because: every shard delta transition across SQLite store must exactly reproduce full trie rebuild
controls.can_fail_because: if apply_insert, delta commitment, or fold had an incorrect trie split case
controls.null_must_contain: divergence between bound delta fold and full trie rebuild

controls.name: C2_fork_injection_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: verifier must reject forged delta_n fork injections and key set mismatches with 100% precision
controls.can_fail_because: if delta_n equality check was bypassed or evaluated lazily
controls.null_must_contain: accepted forged delta_n or split sequence chain head on identical state root

controls.name: C3_epoch_inflation_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: verifier must reject empty delta_proofs and zero-cost epoch inflation attempts
controls.can_fail_because: if apply_epoch permitted empty proof lists to advance chain head
controls.null_must_contain: epoch counter advancing on empty or unauthenticated delta

controls.name: C4_constant_memory_72B_invariant
controls.must_fire_because: verifier resident memory must remain strictly 72 bytes invariant across all shard and stream transitions
controls.can_fail_because: if verifier cached historical proofs, intermediate roots, or CID index entries
controls.null_must_contain: growing verifier RAM with atomspace or shard volume

controls.name: C5_sqlite_shardstore_integrity_verified
controls.must_fire_because: all shard blobs in SQLite index.db must verify multihash integrity upon retrieval
controls.can_fail_because: if ShardStore path resolution or SQLite connection failed
controls.null_must_contain: corrupted CID multihashes or missing blobs in store

controls.name: C6_bandwidth_savings_over_full_sync
controls.must_fire_because: cumulative streaming witness wire size must be strictly smaller than full snapshot sync
controls.can_fail_because: if auth path overhead exceeded cumulative space payloads
controls.null_must_contain: witness proofs consuming more bandwidth than full state transfer

controls.name: C7_tampered_proofs_rejected_atomically
controls.must_fire_because: tampered witness proofs must be rejected atomically without state corruption
controls.can_fail_because: if verify_insert accepted modified step digests
controls.null_must_contain: accepted corrupted proofs or corrupted verifier root

controls.name: C8_downstream_queries_authenticated
controls.must_fire_because: final live streaming root must authenticate downstream membership, absence, and completeness queries
controls.can_fail_because: if streaming fold diverged from honest trie state
controls.null_must_contain: failing queries on live bound root

falsifiers.name: F_bound_streaming_advantage
falsifiers.can_fail_because: verifier memory > 128 bytes, or fork injection succeeds, or inflation succeeds, or MEDIAN shard transition latency > 500us AT AN ASSERTED QUIET OPERATING POINT (H206: unassertable load -> that term is UNASSERTED, never silently "did not fire"), or witness bandwidth >= full snapshot at depth >= 20
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a verifier with memory bloat, fork vulnerability, or excessive latency
